content: The current code after saving parent sets `self.field.attname = self._get_pk_val(parent._meta)`, syncing link field from parent PK post-save; pre-save sync condition targets new instances where link was set directly but parent PK not yet synced. For existing instances with parent PK explicitly set to None, link must be cleared. Proposed fix: modify sync condition to check `self._state.adding`; since child save always saves parent first, after first save both are added, and `save_base` sets `adding=False` at end, so during `_save_parents` `adding` is True for first-time save and False for subsequent saves—condition distinguishes correctly. Trace: child saved initially uid=1,item_ptr_id=1; user sets uid=None (not saved) f=False; save→save_base→_save_parents: parent=Item, field=item_ptr OneToOneField; getattr(self,'uid') is None; getattr(self,'item_ptr_id') is 1; with fix `if not self._state.adding` (False) setattr item_ptr_id=None; both None; parent_inserted = _save_parents(Item) → no parents → False; _save_table(Item): pk_val=uid=None, pk_set=False, force_insert=False; goes to INSERT; fields excludes auto_field (uid) since pk_set=False; `get_pk_value_on_save` for AutoField returns None (no default), pk_set stays False; INSERT runs without uid, DB assigns new auto-increment. After INSERT, if returning_fields empty (SQLite), no setattr in `_do_insert` loop; instance's uid remains None—potential problem. `_do_insert` returns manager._insert with returning_fields; QuerySet._insert sets attrs only for returning_fields, otherwise doesn't set PK if no returning_fields; need to verify how AutoField's new value gets back to instance (possibly via cursor.lastrowid). Next: test scenario creating new Item without pk and saving to see if pk is set.
